reasoning: The icon depicts a standard user/person bust paired with an exclamation mark, clearly communicating an account alert, user issue, emergency contact, or flagged profile. It fits specific real-world tasks around resolving account lockouts, security alerts, HR/moderation issues, and emergency contacts, though it must not be overused for any merely 'urgent' task involving a person.
